legend: After studying linear algebra for machine learning, Leonid decided to return to discrete problems. One of them he liked so much that he decided to share it with you.

There is an array of non-zero integers a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$, where a positive number x$$$x$$$ in the array corresponds to x$$$x$$$ opening brackets, and a negative number corresponds to −x$$$-x$$$ closing brackets. For example, the array [3, -2] corresponds to ((()).

A subarray al,al+1,…,ar$$$a_l, a_{l+1}, \ldots, a_r$$$, where (l≤r)$$$(l \le r)$$$ is called good$$$good$$$ if its elements can be rearranged to form an array b1,b2,…,br−l+1$$$b_1, b_2, \ldots, b_{r-l+1}$$$ such that the corresponding bracket sequence is balanced and there is at least one negative number among any two consecutive elements of the array b$$$b$$$.
For the given array a$$$a$$$, you need to count the number of its good$$$good$$$ subarrays.
A bracket sequence is called balanced if it can be turned into a correct mathematical expression by adding the symbols + and 1.
input: The first line of input contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤5⋅105)$$$(1 \le n \le 5 \cdot 10^5)$$$.
The second line contains n$$$n$$$ numbers a1,a2,…,an(1≤|ai|≤109)$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n\, (1 \le |a_i| \le 10^9)$$$.
output: In a single line, output one number – the answer to the problem.

legend.ai: 在学习机器学习中的线性代数后，Leonid 决定重新回到离散问题上来。其中有一道题他非常喜欢，于是决定与你分享。
存在一个由非零整数组成的数组 a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$，其中数组中的正数 x$$$x$$$ 对应 x$$$x$$$ 个左括号，而负数对应 −x$$$-x$$$ 个右括号。例如，数组 [3, -2] 对应括号序列 ((())。

如果子数组 al,al+1,…,ar$$$a_l, a_{l+1}, \ldots, a_r$$$(其中 (l≤r)$$$(l \le r)$$$)的元素可以重新排列成数组 b1,b2,…,br−l+1$$$b_1, b_2, \ldots, b_{r-l+1}$$$，使得对应的括号序列是平衡的，并且数组 b$$$b$$$ 中任意两个相邻元素之间至少有一个负数，则称其为好子数组$$$good$$$。
给定数组 a$$$a$$$，你需要统计其好$$$good$$$子数组的数量。
一个括号序列若可以通过添加符号 + 和 1 变成正确的数学表达式，则称它是平衡的。
